title: AION 2 Macro Guide: Keybind and Skill Priority
description: Set up AION 2’s built-in skill macro from a launch-period menu demonstration, understand stack priority and test delay without copying unverified class templates.
summary: Bind the activation key, choose a small hotbar stack and test each attack. Keep healing and other decisions reachable; older KR/TW delay recommendations need Global checks.
quickAnswer: Bind the built-in ability macro under Key Settings → General → Gameplay, open its editor and select a hotbar skill stack. Start with a short damage sequence and keep healing, movement and interrupts on separate controls; this menu flow is player-reported.
